subject: This week's strangest signals: Ozempic/Wegovy usage footprint, Developer chatter about Nvidia
preheader: Ozempic/Wegovy usage footprint for Novo Nordisk: −59% (11,819 → 4,820) vs the same period last year. Plus 4 more offbeat moves, explained in plain English.

picks.basis: vs the same period last year
picks.plain: Report volume is below a year ago.
picks.what: Reports of side effects filed with the FDA that mention semaglutide, Novo's blockbuster drug.
picks.why: More patients means more reports, so the trend is a rough proxy for how fast use is growing in the U.S. Caveat: a spike can also flag a real safety issue.

picks.plain: Engineers are talking about Nvidia more than usual.
picks.what: How often “nvidia” shows up in stories posted to Hacker News, the news board many software engineers read.
picks.why: Engineers talk about the chips they want and can't get.

picks.plain: Public curiosity about On is fading.
picks.what: How many people look up “On (company)” on Wikipedia each day.
picks.why: On is a fast-growing brand, and its growth depends on more people discovering its shoes.

picks.plain: More developers are building on Shopify than a month ago.
picks.what: Daily downloads of @shopify/shopify-api, Shopify's official JavaScript toolkit for building store apps.
picks.why: Shopify grows when more merchants and app makers build on it.

picks.plain: Public curiosity about Palantir is fading.
picks.what: How many people look up “Palantir Technologies” on Wikipedia each day.
picks.why: Palantir is one of the most popular stocks with everyday investors.

story.title: Ozempic/Wegovy usage footprint fell 59% (11,819 → 4,820) (vs the same period last year)
paragraphs: Reports of side effects filed with the FDA that mention semaglutide, Novo's blockbuster drug. Report counts tend to grow with the number of people taking a drug.
Why it might matter for Novo Nordisk: more patients means more reports, so the trend is a rough proxy for how fast use is growing in the U.S. Caveat: a spike can also flag a real safety issue.
What it shows now: report volume is below a year ago.
